recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Do not edit archived release history bundles as a current-spec fix; revisit only if maintainers separately choose to retroactively correct historical release artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-13549 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Goal change request raised for STU3. It asked that the Goal start-date and target-date SearchParameter FHIRPath expressions use lowercase date rather than uppercase Date.
initial_application: The Jira snapshot records the application as svn revision 12701, but no explicit FHIR-13549/GF#13549/svn 12701 source commit was found in the current git history. Current source history shows the Goal search-parameter source imported with lowercase as date expressions and later migrated to ofType(date).
additional_context: Goal is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/goal/bundle-Goal-search-params.xml is the current build-scope source for the resource search parameters. Archived tools/history/release3/search-parameters.xml still contains the old uppercase Date expressions, while R4/R4B history and current source use lowercase date; the remaining uppercase occurrence is historical release material, not current authoritative source. Related FHIR-12400, FHIR-7885, and FHIR-5328 audits are already on the combined branch. Community searches found no conflicting work-group evidence beyond a Zulip tracker-item bot notification.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active current Goal-start-date expression is (Goal.start.ofType(date)) and the active current Goal-target-date expression is (Goal.target.due.ofType(date)), preserving the lowercase primitive type required by the Jira decision.

related_jiras.note: Added/audited the Goal start-date search parameter and confirms its current-build presence; already represented on the combined branch.
Established Goal.start[x] as the date-or-event element behind the start-date expression; already represented on the combined branch.
Established Goal target timing support behind the target-date expression; already represented on the combined branch.
